An '''adjutant''' was a trusted assistant. In the military, they were an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] appointed as an assistant to a more senior officer. Other organizations, such as [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]], the [[Chirq Council]], and the [[Darkwalkers]], appointed adjutants. 

==History==
Within the military of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], adjutants were assigned to assist Imperial [[General/Legends|generals]] in command of [[IM-455 modular garrison]]s.<ref name="SWS" /> [[Ssssk!]]<ref name="SW84">[[Star Wars (1977) 84|''Star Wars'' (1977) 84]]</ref> and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sandrex Olotho]] were both adjutants for the Empire.<ref name="HR">''[[Heroes & Rogues]]''</ref>

Criminal gangs also used the position of adjutant. [[Guri]] served as adjutant to [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Xizor/Legends|Xizor]],<ref name="EGWT" /> while [[Vora Anjek]] served the [[Chirq Council]] as one.<ref name="SWG-Starter">{{GalaxiesNGE}}</ref> The [[Darkwalkers]] also had an adjutant who served beneath the [[Underlord]] which gave them a degree of authority.<ref name="Darkwalker">{{SWGTCG|set=The Price of Victory|cardname=Darkwalker Adjutant}}</ref>
